name: NRG Bloom Operational Impact Data
description: Key operational, environmental, and financial metrics from NRG Bloom's modular data center deployments on stranded energy sources.
license: Data may be cited with attribution to NRG Bloom Inc. (https://nrgbloom.com)

environmental.methodology: Displacement of methane flaring through productive combustion in gas generators powering compute infrastructure
environmental.carbon_position: 300+ tonnes CO2e mitigated to date. NRG Bloom does not claim a carbon-negative position pending third-party verification.
environmental.verification_standard: Aligned with UNFCCC CDM methodology AM0009 (recovery and utilization of gas from oil fields that would otherwise be flared or vented). Not third-party verified.
environmental.verification_status: Unverified. No credits have been issued.
